description: This file defines a class 'Cumulative' that provides methods for calculating cumulative interest and principal payments on loans over specified periods. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's financial calculation functions, specifically related to cash flow calculations.

classes.name: Cumulative
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate cumulative interest and principal for loans over specified periods, used internally by the PhpSpreadsheet financial functions.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative interest paid on a loan between two periods using the CUMIPMT formula.

methods.name: principal
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative principal paid on a loan between two periods using the CUMPRINC formula.
